author: blu
body: Bitmap icon system. Icons are fixed-size pixel grids stored as flat integer lists (1 = foreground, 0 = background). Standard icons ship at 8x8, 12x12, 16x16, 24x24, and 32x32. An IconSet provides named+sized lookup with nearest-size fallback. Icons render with foreground/background color override so the same icon works across any theme. Nearest-neighbor scaling lets you define once and resize on demand.
